Method: Investigative journalism tests claims the way a newsroom tests a story: interview witnesses, cross-check accounts, follow the evidence where it leads, and separate fact from spin. Strobel, an award-winning legal journalist and former atheist, turned those tools on the Gospels - and became convinced.
BiblicalInsight: The Gospels survive journalistic scrutiny: multiple witnesses, early testimony, and details that ring true under cross-examination. Faith need not fear questions; it can invite them.
